description: With an automated training paradigm, planarians showed environmental familiarization lasting at least 14 days, and trained worms whose heads were removed showed memory savings after regenerating a new head.
limitations: Savings effect after regeneration. Earlier manual planarian memory studies were confounded, which this paradigm was built to avoid.

sources.quote: trained, decapitated planarians exhibit evidence of memory retrieval in a savings paradigm after regenerating a new head
